title: Asa Reforms Judah

questions.question: Who reigned in Abijah's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:1 (ESV): "...and Asa his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What did Asa do that was right?
options: He took away the foreign altars and the high places
questions.correctAnswer: He took away the foreign altars and the high places
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:3 (ESV): "He took away the foreign altars and the high places and broke down the pillars..."

questions.question: What did the land have under Asa initially?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:1 (ESV): "...In his days the land had rest for ten years."

questions.question: Who came out against them with an army of a million men?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:9 (ESV): "Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million men..."

questions.question: What did Asa do when faced with the huge army?
options: He cried to the LORD his God
questions.correctAnswer: He cried to the LORD his God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:11 (ESV): "And Asa cried to the LORD his God, 'O LORD, there is none like you to help...'"

questions.question: How many years of rest did the land have?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:1 (ESV): "...In his days the land had rest for ten years."

questions.question: What did Asa command Judah to do?
options: Seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and keep the law
questions.correctAnswer: Seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and keep the law
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:4 (ESV): "commanded Judah to seek the LORD... and to keep the law..."

questions.question: How many men did Asa have from Judah bearing shields and spears?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:8 (ESV): "And Asa had an army of 300,000 from Judah..."

questions.question: How many men did Asa have from Benjamin?
Where did the battle take place?
options: In the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah
questions.correctAnswer: In the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:10 (ESV): "...and they drew up their lines of battle in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah."

questions.question: What happened to the Ethiopians?
options: They were defeated and fled, and could not recover
questions.correctAnswer: They were defeated and fled, and could not recover
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:12-13 (ESV): "So the LORD defeated the Ethiopians... and the Ethiopians fled... for they were broken before the LORD..."

questions.question: How far did Asa pursue them?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:13 (ESV): "Asa and the people who were with him pursued them as far as Gerar..."

questions.question: What fell upon the cities around Gerar?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:14 (ESV): "...for the dread of the LORD was upon them."

questions.question: What did Asa say about the LORD's ability to help?
options: There is none like You to help, between the mighty and the weak
questions.correctAnswer: There is none like You to help, between the mighty and the weak
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:11 (ESV): "...O LORD, there is none like you to help, between the mighty and the weak."

questions.question: What request did Asa make concluding his prayer?
options: Let not man prevail against you
questions.correctAnswer: Let not man prevail against you
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 14:11 (ESV): "...let not man prevail against you."

key_verse_text: And Asa cried to the LORD his God, “O LORD, there is none like you to help, between the mighty and the weak. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, you are our God; let not man prevail against you.”
